description: This file implements an Android Activity demonstrating different animation interpolators applied to a view. It provides a UI with a spinner for selecting the interpolator type and animates a target view with the selected interpolator.

classes.name: Animation3
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating the use of different interpolators in animation, controlled via a spinner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the spinner with interpolator options.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an interpolator from the spinner, creates and applies the corresponding animation to the target view.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: No operation when no spinner item is selected.
